items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I had, I had, Jules Barnes was playing with me then.

ctx.x: That's right. That's the Flying Mexican Hall. Down in Jules's Lane. Was that Algiers? That's Algiers. Over in Algiers. Jules's Lane.
Jules Lee was the, wait, Jules Barnes.
The trombone, and Lee was the drummer.
